title: Is Bitcoin’s bull run back on track? 8% price hike says…
summary: Bitcoin has surpassed the yearly moving average for the first time since November 2025.
content: Bitcoin has recently experienced an 8 percent price hike, prompting questions about whether its bull run has returned. This upward movement follows Bitcoin surpassing its yearly moving average for the first time since November 2025, signaling a potential shift in market momentum for the cryptocurrency.
